subfield_thickness_accuracy.description: Paper-reported subfield thickness accuracy against manual measurements; reproduced scores use the packaged procedural benchmark.

thickness_mae_mm.description: Mean absolute error between predicted and reference subfield thickness values.

thickness_p95_abs_error_mm.description: Ninety-fifth percentile absolute thickness error, penalizing localized failures hidden by the mean.

valid_spoke_fraction.description: Fraction of anatomical spokes that remain valid, preventing thickness gains from invalid geometry.

correspondence_stability.description: Paper-reported cross-sectional and longitudinal landmark correspondence errors versus shape-model baselines.

cross_sectional_correspondence_error_mm.description: Mean landmark localization error on baseline cross-sectional subjects.

cross_sectional_p95_correspondence_error.description: Ninety-fifth percentile cross-sectional landmark error, catching methods tuned only to average landmarks.

longitudinal_correspondence_error_mm.description: Mean landmark localization error on longitudinal atrophy-like follow-up subjects.

longitudinal_p95_correspondence_error_mm.description: Ninety-fifth percentile longitudinal landmark error, exposing unstable follow-up correspondences.

valid_spoke_fraction.description: Fraction of anatomical spokes that remain valid while preserving landmark correspondence.

surface_robustness.description: Paper-reported reconstruction agreement for cognitively impaired subjects, used as a geometric-fidelity constraint.

surface_q_mm.description: Maximum bidirectional surface reconstruction distance retained as a reported diagnostic; zero-weighted because it is identical to surface_HD_mm in this point-cloud scorer.

surface_HD_mm.description: Hausdorff surface reconstruction distance, guarding against severe geometric outliers.

surface_p95_mm.description: Ninety-fifth percentile bidirectional surface distance, adding a tail metric less brittle than the maximum.

valid_spoke_fraction.description: Fraction of anatomical spokes that remain valid under reconstructed surface geometry.
